cards.answer: Lucian is an AD-focused marksman who follows abilities with double-shot attacks. His piercing shot and ultimate deal physical damage, while Lightslinger hits shorten his dash cooldown. Avoid extended attack exchanges and step away from his firing line.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended attack exchanges and step away from his firing line.

cards.answer: Lightslinger makes Lucian's next basic attack after an ability fire an additional shot that deals reduced physical damage. Allied healing or shielding, or a nearby enemy champion being immobilized, empowers his next shots with bonus magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Give him space after he casts or receives allied support.

citations.quote: Innate: After casting an ability, Lucian's next basic attack within a few seconds fires a second attack that deals reduced physical damage.

facts.claim: Lightslinger makes Lucian's next basic attack after an ability fire an additional shot that deals reduced physical damage.

citations.quote: Innate - Vigilance: Whenever Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is immobilized, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal 5 (+ 15% AD) bonus magic damage on-hit.

facts.claim: Allied healing or shielding, or a nearby enemy champion being immobilized, empowers his next shots with bonus magic damage.

cards.priority_reason: His passive defines his trading pattern and explains increased damage around allied support.

cards.answer: Piercing Light targets an enemy and deals physical damage along a line through them. Changing position during its cast can dodge the laser.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lining up behind his target and move sideways during the cast.

citations.quote: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

facts.claim: Piercing Light targets an enemy and deals physical damage along a line through them.

citations.quote: Piercing Light will attempt to lead the target if it is moving but does not adjust further during the cast time (enemies can dodge the laser if they change their position by a sufficient amount during the cast time).

facts.claim: Changing position during its cast can dodge the laser.

cards.priority_reason: Its piercing line threatens enemies beyond the selected target.

cards.answer: Ardent Blaze fires an exploding missile that deals magic damage, marks enemies hit, and briefly reveals the area. Damage from Lucian or allied champions to a marked target grants Lucian movement speed; allied champions triggering this also empower his shots with Vigilance.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the missile and pull back when marked to limit his pursuit.

citations.quote: Active: Lucian fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and granting sight of the area for 1 second.
Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.

facts.claim: Ardent Blaze fires an exploding missile that deals magic damage, marks enemies hit, and briefly reveals the area.

facts.claim: Damage from Lucian or allied champions to a marked target grants Lucian movement speed; allied champions triggering this also empower his shots with Vigilance.

cards.answer: Relentless Pursuit dashes in a chosen direction and can cross terrain. Lightslinger hits reduce its remaining cooldown, with a stronger reduction against champions. Lucian can dash during The Culling.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance after his dash and limit his follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: The Culling channels a stream of bullets in a chosen direction, with each bullet dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit. Lucian can move while channeling and can end the channel early.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the firing line or use minions as cover.
